understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid, modify the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation to match each goal cell's requirements, then step onto every goal to complete each level and ultimately win the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement consumes stamina, and blocked moves still consume stamina without changing position. Shape modifiers cycle the piece's shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90° clockwise. A goal activates only when shape, color, and rotation all match simultaneously. Depleting stamina costs a life and resets stamina; losing all lives ends the game.
